summary.text: Cornel Rasor represents Idaho House District 1, Seat B, and lives in Sagle; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a second term and a business owner occupation.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Rasor was raised in Bonner County on a family cattle ranch, graduated from Sandpoint High School, and operated the Sandpoint Army Surplus Store for 43 years.
The biography also says Rasor served as a Bonner County commissioner.
